description.default: The DocuSign account ID the acceptance flow sends envelopes through. Assigned per environment/DocuSign account, so it cannot come from source (C-TECH-047). Take it from the DocuSign account settings page for the account the environment's rev-docusign connection authenticates against.

hint.default: DocuSign > Settings > Apps and Keys > API Account ID, for the account the rev-docusign connection in this environment is bound to. Required: the acceptance flow cannot address the DocuSign API without it.
